interfaces.name: ItemIdentifier
interfaces.doc: Identifies a highlighted / clicked / focused item.

interfaces.name: BaseSeriesOptions
interfaces.doc: Properties shared by all series. Data can be provided in three ways: 1. `data` as an array of values aligned with the category axis `data` 2. `dataKey` reading a field from the chart `dataset` 3. long-format rows (`data` rows or chart-level `data`) with `dimension` / `metric` fields, optionally split into several series by `groupBy` (one series per distinct value, in order of first appearance)

props.name: color
props.doc: Static color (CSS color or theme token).

props.name: colorField
props.doc: Field holding a per-row CSS color (bypasses the palette).

props.name: colors
props.doc: Explicit palette for the groups produced by `groupBy`.

props.name: excludeFromInteraction
props.doc: Rows / items excluded from interaction (tooltip, highlight).

props.name: stack
props.doc: Series sharing a stack id are stacked.

props.name: layout
props.doc: 'horizontal' draws bars along the x axis.

props.name: roundCorners
props.doc: Round only the outer end of a bar (default) or every corner.

props.name: barLabel
props.type: 'value' | ((item: { value: number | null; dataIndex: number; seriesId: string }) => string | null)

props.name: area
props.doc: Fill below the line. `true` uses the line color at 30% opacity.

props.name: gradient
props.doc: Gradient area fill fading to transparent.

props.name: showMark
props.type: boolean | 'start' | 'end' | ((p: { index: number; value: number | null }) => boolean)

props.name: alternateField
props.doc: Field with a truthy value for points drawn with the alternate dash (e.g. forecasts).

props.name: sampling
props.doc: Downsampling for dense series ('auto' = min-max above 2 points per pixel).

props.name: metricRanges
props.doc: Bands between two fields drawn around the line (confidence intervals, targets).

props.name: lineTypeField
props.doc: Field whose distinct values select a dash pattern from `lineTypes` (one per group).

props.name: displayOnHover
props.doc: Only show the range while its series is highlighted.

props.name: metricStart
props.doc: Floating band between two metrics (disables stacking).

props.name: sizeField
props.doc: Field used for the bubble size (or `size` on point objects).

props.name: sizeRange
props.doc: [min, max] pixel diameter when sized by a field.

props.name: colorValueField
props.doc: Continuous color by a numeric field using `colorScheme`.

props.name: positions
props.doc: Typed array fast path: interleaved [x0, y0, x1, y1, …]. Skips per-item transitions.

props.name: innerRadius
props.doc: Px or percentage of the available radius, e.g. '60%'.

props.name: startAngle
props.doc: Degrees.

props.name: paddingAngle
props.doc: Degrees between slices.

props.name: centerLabel
props.doc: Content drawn in the center of a donut.

props.name: data
props.doc: Categories / values for ordinal axes.

props.name: tickValues
props.doc: Explicit tick values.

props.name: baseline
props.doc: Draws a highlighted 0 line.

props.name: labelLimit
props.doc: Max label width in px before truncation (ordinal axes).

props.name: zoom
props.type: boolean | { minSpan?: number; maxSpan?: number; slider?: boolean }
props.doc: Enables wheel / drag zoom on this axis (continuous axes).

props.name: groups
props.doc: Grouped (multi-level) category labels. Each level maps a category to its group; consecutive categories with the same group share one bracketed label. Levels are drawn outward from the axis (ordinal axes only).

props.name: thumbnails
props.doc: Images drawn next to each tick (e.g. logos, avatars, flags).

props.name: annotations
props.doc: Event markers and spans drawn in a lane alongside the axis.

props.name: annotationFormat
props.doc: `span` draws every annotation; `summary` collapses them into one badge.

props.name: getValue
props.type: (value: DomainValue, index: number) => string | number | null | undefined
props.doc: Group key for a category.

props.name: format
props.doc: Optional label formatter for the group key.

props.name: url
props.doc: Image URL for a tick value (undefined draws nothing).

props.name: size
props.doc: Box size in px. Default 24.

props.name: radius
props.doc: Corner radius in px (use size / 2 for circles). Default 4.

props.name: hideLabel
props.doc: Hides the text label and shows only the image.

props.name: value
props.doc: Single position (draws a marker).

props.name: start
props.doc: Span start / end (draws a bar).

props.name: description
props.doc: Longer text shown in the tooltip.

interfaces.name: PointAnnotationOptions
interfaces.doc: A labelled callout attached to a data point.

props.name: x
props.doc: x value (category, number or date).

props.name: y
props.doc: y value; when omitted it is read from `seriesId` at `x`.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: Side of the point the label sits on. Default 'top'.

props.name: offset
props.doc: Leader line length in px. Default 26.

props.name: marker
props.doc: Draws a ring around the point. Default true.

interfaces.name: ScatterPathOptions
interfaces.doc: Lines connecting scatter points (trajectories, before/after pairs).

props.name: groupBy
props.doc: Datum field that splits points into separate paths.

props.name: order
props.doc: Order points by x or keep data order. Default 'data'.

interfaces.name: ScatterLabelOptions
interfaces.doc: Text labels next to scatter points, skipping labels that would overlap.

props.name: field
props.doc: Datum field to show; defaults to the point's y value.

props.name: indices
props.doc: Only label these data indices.

props.name: toggleable
props.doc: Click toggles series visibility.

props.name: highlight
props.doc: Hover highlights the series.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Overrides displayed labels by series id.

props.name: hiddenEntries
props.doc: Series ids not shown in the legend.

props.name: anchor
props.doc: Anchor at the cursor or at the mark.

props.name: customContent
props.doc: When true the engine positions the container but leaves content to the host (e.g. React portal).

props.name: render
props.doc: Plain DOM rendering hook.

props.name: x1
props.doc: Data-space corners; omit a bound to extend to the plot edge.

props.name: seriesId
props.doc: Series the trendline is computed from (default: every visible cartesian series).

props.name: extend
props.doc: Extend the line to the full x domain (regressions only).

props.name: label
props.doc: Label drawn at the end of the line; receives the last trend value.

props.name: enter
props.doc: Initial draw-in animation.

props.name: data
props.doc: Long-format rows shared by series that use `dimension` / `metric`.

props.name: dataset
props.doc: Wide-format rows used by `dataKey`.

props.name: trendlines
props.doc: Regression / smoothing lines over series (requires the annotations plugin).

props.name: pointAnnotations
props.doc: Labelled callouts on data points (requires the annotations plugin).

props.name: scatterPaths
props.doc: Paths connecting scatter points (requires the annotations plugin).

props.name: scatterLabels
props.doc: Labels next to scatter points (requires the annotations plugin).

props.name: marquee
props.doc: Drag to select. Default action zooms into the selection (double-click, Esc or the reset chip go back); `{ action: 'select' }` keeps it and reports the covered items. Loaded on demand.

props.name: toolbar
props.doc: Adds the toolbar plugin (zoom, downloads, print, full screen) when using hosts that read it.

props.name: initialZoom
props.doc: Initial zoom windows (requires the zoom plugin).

props.name: description
props.doc: Accessible description; auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: hiddenSeries
props.doc: Controlled hidden series ids.

props.name: defaultHiddenSeries
props.doc: Initial hidden series ids (uncontrolled).

props.name: highlightedItem
props.doc: Controlled highlight. `null` clears; `undefined` leaves it uncontrolled.

props.name: onItemClick
props.type: (item: ItemIdentifier & { datum?: Datum; value?: number | null }, event: PointerEvent) => void

props.name: onItemContextMenu
props.type: (item: ItemIdentifier & { datum?: Datum }, event: MouseEvent) => void

props.name: onAxisClick
props.type: (data: { axisValue: DomainValue; dataIndex: number }, event: PointerEvent) => void

props.name: xField
props.doc: Field names (rows) — tuples `[x, y, value]` are accepted too.

props.name: colorScheme
props.doc: Sequential / diverging scheme name (e.g. 'viridis', 'redBlue').

props.name: thresholds
props.doc: Piecewise color map: values below each threshold get its color.

props.name: colorDomain
props.doc: Domain for the continuous color map (defaults to the data extent).

props.name: bodyWidth
props.doc: Body width as a fraction of the band.

props.name: style
props.doc: 'candle' (filled bodies) or 'ohlc' (bars with open / close ticks).

props.name: volume
props.doc: Field with traded volume; drawn as bars along the bottom of the plot.

props.name: volumeHeight
props.doc: Fraction of the plot height used by volume bars. Default 0.2.

props.name: lastPrice
props.type: boolean | { color?: ColorInput; format?: (v: number) => string }
props.doc: Dashed line at the last close with a price badge on the right edge.

props.name: layout
props.doc: 'horizontal' gives Gantt-style timelines.

props.name: progressField
props.doc: Optional progress field (0..1) drawn as an inner bar (Gantt).

props.name: totalField
props.doc: Rows whose field is truthy are drawn as totals (from zero).

props.name: whiskers
props.doc: 'iqr' uses 1.5×IQR whiskers with outliers; 'minmax' spans all values.

props.name: variant
props.doc: 'funnel' narrows to the last value, 'pyramid' is triangular.

props.name: gap
props.doc: Gap between sections (px).

props.name: sectionLabel
props.doc: Label inside each section: value, percent of first, or label.

props.name: depth
props.doc: Depth of nodes that are drawn (1 = top level children).

props.name: nodes
props.type: { id: string; label?: string; color?: ColorInput }[]

props.name: data
props.doc: Rows: { label, value, target, max?, thresholds? }.

props.name: metrics
props.doc: Metric names (axes) in order; values read from rows by name.

props.name: max
props.doc: Max per metric (defaults to the max across series).

props.name: matrix
props.doc: Square matrix of flows; matrix[i][j] = flow from i to j.

props.name: startAngle
props.doc: Degrees.

props.name: geoJson
props.doc: GeoJSON FeatureCollection.

props.name: idProperty
props.doc: Property used as region id.

props.name: rotate
props.doc: Orthographic rotation [lambda, phi] in degrees.

props.name: mode
props.doc: Shape every item takes; changing it morphs items on the GPU.

props.name: span
props.doc: Visible span in axis units (ms for time axes); null resets.

props.name: slider
props.doc: Zoom slider with a data preview below the plot.

props.name: wheel
props.doc: Wheel / trackpad-pinch zoom. Default true.

props.name: pan
props.doc: Drag to pan. Default true (Shift+drag when a marquee owns plain drags).

props.name: keyboard
props.doc: +/- / 0 and Shift+arrows. Default true.

props.name: rangeButtons
props.doc: Preset spans shown as buttons in the top-right corner.

props.name: minSpan
props.doc: Smallest visible span, in axis units.

props.name: x
props.doc: Selected x range (numbers for continuous axes, categories for ordinal axes).

props.name: y
props.doc: Selected y range ('y' and 'xy' modes, or a category range on ordinal y axes).

props.name: items
props.type: { seriesId: string; dataIndex: number; datum?: Datum; x?: DomainValue; y?: number | null }[]
props.doc: Items inside the selection.

interfaces.name: MarqueeState
interfaces.doc: Live marquee state: pixel positions (plot coordinates) and the selection they cover.

props.name: active
props.doc: True while dragging; false for a selection kept after release.

props.name: enabled
props.doc: Default true when options are given.

props.name: action
props.doc: What a finished drag does: zoom into it (default), keep it as a selection, or nothing.

props.name: mode
props.doc: 'x' selects a horizontal range, 'y' a vertical one, 'xy' a rectangle. Default: 'xy' for scatter, 'y' for horizontal bars, else 'x'.

props.name: modifier
props.doc: Require Shift while dragging. Default 'none' (Shift+drag then pans a zoomed chart).

props.name: persist
props.doc: Keep the selection after release ('select' action). Default true.

props.name: overlay
props.doc: Draw the selection rectangle. Default true.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Value badges at the selection edges. Default true.

props.name: preventTooltip
props.doc: Hide tooltips while dragging. Default true.

props.name: preventHighlight
props.doc: Clear hover highlight while dragging. Default true.

props.name: minSize
props.doc: Smallest drag (px) that counts as a selection. Default 6.

props.name: resetButton
props.doc: A "Reset zoom" chip while zoomed by the marquee. Default true.

props.name: onMarquee
props.doc: Called on every change (start, move, release, clear).

props.name: onMarqueeEnd
props.doc: Called when a drag finishes, with the selection (null when cleared).

props.name: zoomOnRelease
props.doc: @deprecated use `action: 'zoom'`.

props.name: x
props.doc: Vertical line. Default true.

props.name: y
props.doc: Horizontal line. Default true.

props.name: badges
props.doc: Value badges on the axes. Default true.

props.name: snap
props.doc: Snap the vertical line to the nearest category / data point. Default true.

props.name: value
props.doc: Which value to show next to the label.

props.name: exclude
props.doc: Series ids to skip.

props.name: directLabels
props.doc: Labels at the end of each line / area series, stacked to avoid overlaps.

props.name: color
props.doc: Data key to split series by color, or a static color `{ value: '#f00' }`.

props.name: colorOverride
props.doc: Field holding a CSS color per row.

props.name: showValues
props.doc: Shows the value next to each bar.

props.name: trellis
props.doc: Data key that splits the chart into small multiples (one panel per value).

props.name: trellisOrientation

props.name: trellisColumns
